d:
Moving a multi-million-dollar mega dredge 100 miles along the Yukon River is Tony Beets' most dangerous gamble yet. With the machinery stranded at Thistle Creek and his barge stalled after firing an incompetent skipper, Tony scrambles to recruit a local river captain to take the helm. It's a race against the dropping temperatures and shallow waters to haul heavy steel and keep the mining season alive.
Watch Gold Rush Season 7, Episode 16 on Discovery Channel India.
